arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Fisher argued the Sixth Amendment requires unanimous juries in state trials.
He cited the Timbs decision to support equal application of rights.
He addressed concerns about reliance on existing non-unanimous verdicts.
Sarah Murrill argued the case presents two distinct legal issues.

paragraphs: the side that brought the case wants the Court to mandate unanimous juries in all state criminal trials.
Louisiana wants the Court to allow states to use non-unanimous juries.
